title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum Arena on 1990-02-25
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (with no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 >  Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC
source: FOB AUD: AKG C-568's > patched thru Panasonic SV-255 > Sony TC-D5M >  TDK MA (1st Set) & TDK MA-XG (2nd Set), with no Dolby. Mics on stand,  thirty feet from the stage, in the center

ai_review.summary: A blues‑heavy show with a solid setlist, but the tape drops in quality at the beginning and the encore's end.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as "very bluesy" with a "sick" set list that makes it worth listening to. The recording holds up for most of the concert, though reviewers note noticeable shortcomings at the start and during the final moments of the encore. Overall it’s an enjoyable listen despite those technical hiccups.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate‑rated review; the show is praised while the recording has specific flaws, leading to an average combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Good for most of the concert but suffers at the very beginning and the end of the encore; no mention of soundboard or audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Blues‑heavy, "sick" set list that keeps interest high despite some recording issues.
